title: Blurring the Block Boundaries: Overlapping Block Denoising for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have emerged as effective alternatives to autoregressive models for latency-critical tasks, enabling faster token generation. Recent advances employ block diffusion with self-editing capabilities, where each block refines tokens iteratively before advancing to the next one. Yet each block is only as fast as its slowest token, and the next block cannot start before it. We suggest Blurring the Block Boundaries (B3), a novel method with which two blocks are refined in parallel within a shared forward pass. B3 calibrates itself on the fly, opening the next block only once the model is ready to start generating it. It is a training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration method which seamlessly integrates within any self-editing block diffusion model. Evaluated on state-of-the-art DLMs across 10 diverse datasets spanning varied tasks and difficulty levels, B3 results in on par generation quality and 11.5-1

translated_title: 模糊块边界：面向高效扩散语言模型的重叠块去噪
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）已成为自回归模型在延迟敏感任务中的有效替代方案，能够实现更快的token生成。最近的进展采用具有自编辑能力的块扩散方法，其中每个块在进入下一个块之前迭代地精炼token。然而，每个块的速度受限于其最慢的token，且下一个块必须等待它完成后才能开始。我们提出了模糊块边界（B3），这是一种新颖的方法，可以在共享的前向传播中并行精炼两个块。B3能够动态地自我校准，只有当模型准备好开始生成下一个块时才会开启它。这是一种无需训练、无需超参数调整的加速方法，可以无缝集成到任何自编辑块扩散模型中。在最先进的扩散语言模型上、跨越不同任务和难度级别的10个多样化数据集上进行评估，B3在实现同等生成质量的同时获得了11.5-1...（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出B3方法，通过在共享前向传播中并行精炼两个块来模糊块边界，实现无需训练和超参数调整的扩散语言模型加速，同时保持生成质量。
en_tdlr: B3 blurs block boundaries by refining two blocks in parallel within a shared forward pass, achieving training-free and hyperparameter-free acceleration for self-editing block diffusion language models while maintaining generation quality.
